name: us-qbi-deduction
description: Compute the 2026 section 199A qualified business income (QBI) deduction for a US sole proprietor or single-member LLC disregarded for federal tax, on Form 8995 or Form 8995-A. The rate stays 20% (the One Big Beautiful Bill Act did not adopt 23%). 2026 figures from Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and Public Law 119-21 section 70105, with thresholds of $201,750 (single and head of household), $201,775 (married filing separately) and $403,500 (joint), phase-in ranges widened to $75,000 and $150,000, and the new $400 minimum deduction for at least $1,000 of QBI from a business the taxpayer materially participates in. Covers QBI after the deductible half of self-employment tax, self-employed health insurance and retirement contributions, the specified service trade or business (SSTB) rules and de minimis test, the W-2 wage and UBIA limit, the phase-in, the 20% of taxable income cap and loss carryforwards. Trigger on "QBI", "199A", "pass-through deduction", "Form 8995", "Form 8995-A", "SSTB", "20% deduct
